name: Net-points strength differential
hypothesis: Teams with a higher net points per game cover a derived point spread more often
inputs: Official standings PF, PA, W, L, T; official schedule
formula: spread_own = f(NPG_home - NPG_away); f is symbolic, coefficient blank

name: Points-allowed total
hypothesis: Points-allowed per game informs a derived game total
inputs: Official standings PA, games played; official schedule

name: Defensive backup-depth deficiency
hypothesis: When a defense starts a 2nd/3rd/4th-string CB, S or EDGE, points allowed rises
inputs: Official club depth charts; official injury report; official inactives
formula: delta_rank = depth_rank(starter) - depth_rank(actual); effect size blank

name: Offensive backup-depth deficiency
hypothesis: When an offense starts a backup QB or skill player, points scored falls
inputs: Official club depth charts (QB, WR, RB, TE); official inactives (emergency third QB)
formula: delta_rank = depth_rank(starter) - depth_rank(actual); effect size blank

name: Practice-status trend
hypothesis: A DNP -> Limited -> Full trend predicts availability and performance
inputs: Official injury report practice status across the three official filing days
formula: trend = ordinal(Full) - ordinal(first report); coefficient blank

name: Designation-gated availability
hypothesis: An official Out/Doubtful/Questionable designation changes the expected lineup
inputs: Official injury report game status; official inactives
formula: indicator = 1 if designation published; effect size blank

name: Two-leg parlay with correlation guard
hypothesis: Two independently validated single-bet signals can be combined
inputs: Official standings, injury report, depth charts; NIST correlation method
formula: P(parlay) = P(A) x P(B) only if corr(A,B) is measured; corr blank

name: Same-game player-prop combo
hypothesis: QB and receiver props in one game are jointly predictable from official player stats
inputs: Official player stats categories; official injury report; official depth charts
formula: joint model requires corr(prop_A, prop_B); corr blank

name: Prop availability gate
hypothesis: Props must be suppressed for officially Out / IR / inactive players
inputs: Official injury report game status; official inactives
formula: rule = block if status in published Out/IR/inactive set

name: Backup-exposure index
hypothesis: A composite of published depth rank and injury designations ranks teams by exposure
inputs: Official depth charts; official injury report; official inactives
formula: index = weighted sum; weights blank until validated
